description: Generates UUID v4s or random bytes, or hashes text with sha256, sha1, sha384, sha512, sha3-256 or md5 (hex or base64). Returns the values requested. Use it for IDs, test data or checksums. Limits: md5 and sha1 are for checksums only, not security; count and byte length are capped.
name: uuid_hash
title: UUIDs, Random Bytes and Hashes
